title: Thread With Caution: Proactively Helping Users Assess and Deescalate Tension in Their Online Discussions
reasoning: The paper focuses on an HCI-based intervention tool (ConvoWizard) used to deescalate incivility in online forum discussions. While it addresses social behavior and includes a section on 'Ethical considerations for technical design', it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, formal moral systems, or theology.
